args.command: cat /root/.grok/auth.json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Auth keys:', list(d.keys())); [print(f'  {k}: token present={bool(v.get(\"key\"))}, expires={v.get(\"expires_at\",\"?\")}') for k,v in d.items()]" 2>&1
export PATH="/root/.grok/bin:$PATH" && echo '{"type":"message","content":"say hello"}' | timeout 15 grok agent stdio 2>&1 | head -30

export PATH="/root/.grok/bin:$PATH" && echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2024-11-05","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"test","version":"1.0"}}}' | timeout 15 grok agent stdio 2>&1 | head -20
export PATH="/root/.grok/bin:$PATH" && timeout 15 grok agent stdio --help 2>&1

export PATH="/root/.grok/bin:$PATH" && echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"prompt","params":{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"say hello world in one line"}]}}' | timeout 30 grok agent stdio 2>&1 | head -50

export PATH="/root/.grok/bin:$PATH" && echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"sampling/createMessage","params":{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"say hello world in one line"}],"maxTokens":100}}' | timeout 30 grok agent stdio 2>&1 | head -50

export PATH="/root/.grok/bin:$PATH" && echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"notifications/initialized","params":{}}' | timeout 5 grok agent stdio 2>&1; echo "---"; echo '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":2,"method":"textDocument/complete","params":{"text":"say hello"}}' | timeout 30 grok agent stdio 2>&1 | head -20

args.content: Grok Build CLI v0.2.14 已安装到 /root/.grok/bin/grok，认证通过（OAuth device-code flow）。但它是交互式 TUI 工具，在无头服务器上无法实际使用。stdio 模式使用私有 JSON-RPC 协议，method 未公开文档。适合本地有终端的开发环境使用，不适合 headless server。安装命令：curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash
